audit_counterexamples.false_other: unmapped/unknown must not become Other Protein Target
audit_counterexamples.local_into_iuphar: local_* must not be written into iuphar_* fields
audit_counterexamples.lost_parents: multi-parent family paths must retain every intact root_to_leaf path
audit_counterexamples.table_distinct: Table.Distinct-style collapse must not pick an arbitrary class

enriched_composite_target.limits: Full classification for RF-003+ runs after dependency joins; seed-only projection remains V30 unless enrich is admitted

standalone_chembl_target.limits: Early standalone call cannot use post-join UniProt/protein-class features; matched counts on partial inputs are not biological accuracy
unavailable_until_joins: normalized primary UniProt accession from idmapping

effective_class.meaning: Final class after the resolution table; may be null

effective_source.meaning: Provenance of effective_class; live tokens are iuphar_normalized, local_rule, or none (resolution maps takes=iuphar → iuphar_normalized)

iuphar_annotation_status.meaning: Availability/completeness of the direct class annotation

iuphar_class.meaning: Direct-layer class from approved type/family mapping only

iuphar_match_status.meaning: Identity outcome against the snapshot catalog

iuphar_target_id.meaning: Matched GtoPdb/IUPHAR public target id from the pinned snapshot

legacy_iuphar_class.meaning: Historical M/Excel class retained for comparison only; not a live write path

local_class.meaning: Class proposed by versioned local rules (EC/annotation/prediction)

local_status.meaning: Support level of the local layer for the row

target_class_profile_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the pinned classification profile envelope

target_type.meaning: ChEMBL object/target type; never overwritten by IUPHAR or local rules

allowed_when: approved family mapping whose class is Other Protein Target
explicit local rule with marks_direct_layer=false supporting that class
legacy_iuphar_class comparison field carrying a historical M/Excel value
forbidden_when: L1/L2 or free-text prediction alone without an explicit local rule

missing_marker_policy.change_rule: A new missing_markers version is a new normalization_version; historical results keep their recorded provenance and are not rewritten

path_policy.graph_defect_policy: cycle, missing parent, depth/visited limits, or truncated walk do not invent a class from a cut path
path_policy.legacy_text_usage: migration/comparison only; never used to choose a class
path_policy.parent_merge_policy: RF-005: repeated family IDs with the same payload union parent sets; conflicting payloads remain a graph defect; path order is canonical sort by (family_id, root_to_leaf), independent of source-row order
path_policy.structure: tuple of family ids from root ancestor to leaf family
path_policy.subclass_policy: iuphar_subclass comes only from the approved type/family dictionary; it does not elevate annotation_capability above family_only
path_policy.synthetic_id_policy: local:/synthetic:/legacy: chains stay outside the official numeric family graph and never become parents of official family IDs
path_policy.table_distinct_policy: Power Query Table.Distinct / unordered collapse is not an identity decision; ambiguous multi-parent or multi-candidate rows stay ambiguous

profile_change_rules.classification_schema_version: Profile envelope field for enabled modes (shadow and enrich): 3.1.0. Distinct from the table/business contract; the adapter rejects a profile that is not 3.1.0
profile_change_rules.immutability: Originals, historical results, and stage-0 copies are preserved; recomputes are separate runs with new digests
profile_change_rules.normalization_version: Missing-marker or identifier normalization changes publish a new normalization_version; current approved value is unset
profile_change_rules.profile_envelope: snapshot_manifest points at the profile envelope; digest is SHA-256 of exact profile bytes; acceptance and biological_accuracy_accepted stay false unless independently proven
profile_change_rules.rules_version: New or edited local/direct rules publish a new rules_version; current baseline is local-rules-2026.11.23
profile_change_rules.table_contract: Business-row / Gold hash scope: off and shadow keep chembl_target_v3.0 (TargetClassificationConfig.contract_version 3.0.0); enrich alone advances to chembl_target_v3.1 / 3.1.0 and the nine additive columns

source_unavailable_vs_not_found.not_found: Snapshot is complete and searchable channels yield no catalog hit
source_unavailable_vs_not_found.source_unavailable: Required snapshot sources are incomplete; absence is not confirmed

annotation.available: Approved type mapping supplies a direct class
annotation.not_available: Matched identity without usable direct annotation
annotation.partial: Only family_only / family mapping supplies a coarse class
annotation.unmapped_type: Provider type/family present but outside approved mappings

completeness.admission_complete: Declared independently reviewed scope is complete for admission
completeness.complete: Global identity/absence coverage of the declared snapshot scope
completeness.family_only: Snapshot/export can supply family paths but not a direct target type
completeness.incomplete: Required snapshot sources or scope receipts are missing

decision.requires_review: Outcome needs human/process review or has conflict codes
decision.resolved: Resolution table selected an outcome without mandatory review
decision.unresolved: No effective class; incomplete rather than conflicting

local.candidate_only: Hints exist but cannot write a supported local class
local.not_supported: No local support; local_class stays empty
local.supported: At least one explicit local rule supports a class

match.contract_error: Internal identity/status inconsistency; processing must not invent a class
match.insufficient_input: Searchable identity input is missing or species-gapped
match.matched: Exactly one catalog identity agreed across exact channels
match.not_found: Snapshot is complete and searchable channels yield no catalog hit
match.source_unavailable: Required snapshot sources are incomplete; absence is not confirmed

uncertainty.ambiguous: Multiple candidates remain; do not collapse silently
uncertainty.conflict: Disagreement between layers or channels; retain conflict codes
uncertainty.not_found: Confirmed absence under a complete searchable snapshot
uncertainty.partial: Coarse or incomplete annotation; not a full direct type proof
uncertainty.source_unavailable: Source/snapshot gap; distinct from confirmed not_found
uncertainty.unknown: Value not computed or not applicable for the row state

component_scope_policy.complex_or_family: A component accession match does not prove identity of a multi-component complex, protein family, or group object; pipeline keeps complex_component_only / ambiguous when the matched catalog id is not itself a complex.
component_scope_policy.name_only: Text channels (exact_name / exact_synonym) never confirm identity alone.
component_scope_policy.single_protein: For SINGLE PROTEIN, primary component accessions identify the object.

diagnostic_codes.auxiliary_uniprot_divergence: Auxiliary UniProt xref hits a different catalog target than the primary decision; recorded as diagnostic, not identity_conflict
diagnostic_codes.identity_conflict: Two or more trusted/primary exact channels disagree; unchanged from pre-RF-002 strict API
diagnostic_codes.unknown_auxiliary_uniprot: Auxiliary UniProt xref has no catalog hit under the active species guard

auxiliary_xref.meaning: Auxiliary UniProt cross-references. Unknown values yield diagnostics; they must not force false ambiguity.

primary.meaning: Primary UniProt accessions of the ChEMBL target object (component list). Mandatory exact-channel anchors.

proven_equivalent.meaning: Xref tokens that duplicate a primary accession. Recorded in evidence; they do not open a second mandatory exact channel.

rf002_identifier_roles.profile_qualification: Profile envelopes and acceptance receipts must pin matching_policy_version to MATCHING_POLICY_VERSION. A pre-RF-002 receipt/profile (missing pin or legacy_matching_policy_version) is rejected by load_profile / validate_acceptance_receipt. RF-008 performs independent biological admission
